name: Joys of Omosh
summary: After your great help, Orokk Omosh shares a family tradition in Orgrimmar. The veteran blacksmith wipes his tears away as soot, then dances for joy to pass on an unusual piece of family heritage.

sections.title: A Soot-Stained Tear
sections.body: At Orgrimmar's forge, Orokk Omosh is known for heavy hammer blows, not tears. Your great help has touched the burly blacksmith deeply. Yet he stubbornly blames a fleck of soot in his eye rather than admit he is weeping.

sections.title: The Omosh Tradition
sections.body: Before you part, Orokk Omosh says he must share one last family secret. He performs the vigorous, exhausting Omosh dance of joy for his apprentice. Then he teaches the apprentice to strike with an iron fist.

faq.answer: Orokk Omosh is an orc blacksmith in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. He takes fierce pride in his family's craft and lineage, and keeps lively traditions beside his smithing.
Orokk Omosh blames forge soot trapped in his eye, but your help has deeply moved him. He has found someone worthy of sharing his family's traditions with.

faq.q: What is the Omosh dance of joy?
faq.answer: The Omosh dance of joy is a vigorous routine passed down through Orokk Omosh's family. It leaves him deeply tired, and he has not practiced it in a very long time.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: The story unfolds in Orgrimmar, at the Valley of Honor forge where Orokk Omosh works metal.
Orokk Omosh teaches you the Omosh dance of joy and promises to pass on the knowledge of the fist of iron, binding smith and adventurer.

faq.q: Can Alliance players participate in this quest?
faq.answer: No. Orokk Omosh is allied with the Horde and lives within Orgrimmar's fortified walls, so only Horde adventurers can meet him there.

angles.text: For a smith, Orokk Omosh's sentimental family dance offers a humorous, tender glimpse of a veteran craftsman's life beyond the forge.
In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, martial pride meets Orokk Omosh's tearful joy and spirited dance amid the clash of steel.
